claim_boundary: Publication-supported plume scale facts may be recorded before the source archive is fully calibrated, but Program A may not sample the plume until exact source bytes, array orientation/origin, and bilateral anatomical sensor geometry independently pass review.

notes: The eLife methods report a PLIF imaging region extending up to 30 cm downwind and 8 cm to either side of the centerline.
The acquisition was 15 Hz and the camera was binned to a nominal 0.74 mm/pixel.
These publication facts do not by themselves prove which archived array axis is downwind/crosswind or where the source lies in the cropped array.

bilateral_sensor_geometry.candidate_landmark_definition: centroid of the olfactory third antennal segment (funiculus) on each side in a scale-calibrated frontal/body-centered projection
forbidden_authority: assuming exact bilateral symmetry without measurement

pass_requirements: exact plume source bytes are SHA-256 verified
archived spatial axes, signs, source origin, and scale are explicitly resolved
left and right anatomical sampling landmarks are independently measured from a scale authority
physical plume and bilateral geometry hashes are frozen before any navigation performance
